meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, wire the DM messaging group to a new agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导创建首个智能体并配置消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速搭建并测试第一个智能体机器人。
copy.tagline_en: Guide through creating the first agent and configuring messaging channels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly set up and test your first agent bot.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会引导你完成 NanoClaw 第一个 DM 频道 agent 的创建:确认频道、你的身份和显示名,运行初始化脚本,生成群组并把欢迎私信交给服务投递。
howto.when: 当你要求为某个 DM 频道创建第一个 agent,且频道凭据已配置、服务正在运行时触发。

say.text: 在 Telegram 初始化第一个 agent,让它直接私信我。
say.note: 可能走配对码流程后再发送欢迎消息。

say.text: 给我的 WhatsApp 初始化第一个 agent,用我的手机号作为身份。
say.note: 会确认平台 ID 后完成创建和欢迎消息发送。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude walks you through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel: it chooses the channel, asks for your user id and display name, runs the init script, and queues a welcome DM through the running service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create the first agent for a DM channel, after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

say_en.text: Set up my first NanoClaw agent on Discord and DM me a welcome message.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for your user id and display name, then initialize.

say_en.text: Initialize the first agent on Telegram and have it DM me.
say_en.note: May use the pair-code flow before sending the welcome DM.

say_en.text: Initialize the first agent for WhatsApp using my phone number.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm the platform id, then create and send the welcome.
